mentions.name: GameBeacon
mentions.description: An LFG (looking for gamers) app and website where gamers can sign up, light a beacon, and invite friends to a game session. Users can also build a game collection, including scanning photos of their physical games with AI.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on GameBeacon, a different take on LFG(looking for gamers) app/website where gamers can sign up, light a beacon and invite friends to a game session.
